scope: Narrow Studio F1 state synchronization correction, reviewed against worker base and matching two-file patch. No source edits or tests were run by this reviewer.

findings.detail: The Studio-only shortcut helper derives Session.help from the visible state (`inspector_open && dock == Help`) before invoking the existing F1 key toggle and route. This removes stale Session.help left behind when a user manually selects Properties or Libraries.

The main update call remains behind the existing `!modal_active()` guard. Studio mode uses the new canonical helper; non-Studio/legacy mode retains the original tikz_canvas::handle_help_shortcut handler.

Regression uses egui selectable_value tabs and actual pointer moved/button press+release events, followed by explicit F1 key down and key up events. It covers Help→Properties→F1 and Help→Libraries→F1, and asserts visible dock/open state.

Regression seeds an actual reversible scientific-literal source edit, verifies source bytes/revision and undo availability remain unchanged through tab clicks/F1, then verifies Undo restores exact original CRLF/Unicode/opaque source.
Separate regression starts with remembered Help while inspector is hidden, verifies F1 reopens Help and subsequent F1 closes to Properties, without source revision or undo mutation.

The baseline regression log records both new cases failing before the helper: pointer-tab F1 did not reopen Help, and hidden remembered Help did not reopen the inspector. Final worker log records both cases passing.
Patch is exactly two files: main.rs shortcut callsite and studio_ui.rs helper/tests. No catalogue, source patch, Undo implementation, native QA coordinates, or acceptance gates are changed.

evidence.native_failure_context: Previous native run03 genuinely showed the second F1 left Properties/domain selected after manual tab selection. This patch has not itself been validated in a new native GUI run.

limitations: Review confirms the code path and worker regression coverage only. It does not confer HOSTED_GUI or NATIVE_PLATFORM acceptance. Repeat the original native operation after integration before accepting the fix.
Final worker test totals are recorded from the supplied log; this reviewer did not rerun tests.
